baseFrontend: validated v84 runtime with authoritative RBAC, restored administrator rights and restart-safe navigation layout
label: v7-10-5
notes: Administrator authority is derived only from the authenticated backend security context; DOM text is never used to classify a role.
Admin keeps full datapoint write access, all overview cards and reversible expert mode.
Installer and End User do not see ioBroker Admin, XTerm, App Center, License, Simulation or account administration.
End User can open Datapoints in read-only mode; backend socket writes are denied independently of the browser.
Navigation visibility/order is stored in eos-admin.0.info.uiTabsVisible and no longer modifies system.config or restarts the adapter.
Backup navigation is shown only while a supported backup instance is enabled.
changes: Removed the legacy DOM-text role heuristic that could downgrade system.user.admin to End User.
Added explicit Admin bypass regression guards in source, backend runtime and frontend bundles.
Added End User-only ObjectBrowser read-only wiring while retaining Admin/Installer native write controls.
Moved menu layout persistence away from system.config into a dedicated adapter state.
Hid Admin/XTerm cards only for restricted roles and forced them visible for Admin.
Protected App Center, License and Simulation in the authenticated role layer and cleared inherited UI-admin sessions for non-admin roles.
